scope.description: Whole mupdf application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Document interpretation/rendering, text/search, page manipulation, annotations/forms, editing, conversion and supported document formats.

coverage.rationale: Core PDF viewing/extraction functions are connected, but document editing, interaction and non-PDF formats are largely absent.

scope.description: Selected passive PDF pages to rendered PNGs, UTF-8 text and page geometry for review.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Ordered review pages and DPI hide native invocation/readback, while pagination and rendering choices remain explicit.

limitations: Bounded unencrypted passive PDF pages only; no OCR, editing, authored scripts or general viewer interactions; extracted text follows native content order.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
